notes:
**Fixes & polish**

- **Typing is saved even after you switch away and come back.** If the window lost focus while you were writing — switching apps, the emoji panel, a system pop-up, Stage Manager — the editor could stop saving what you typed afterwards. The text stayed on screen but never reached the database, so it was lost on the next restart. Typed and IME text now always saves. (#1282; fixed in #1288.)
- **Very deeply nested bullet lists open again.** A long chain of indented bullets could make a note open empty. Deep nesting now loads normally, and an empty load can no longer be saved back over the real note. (#1653.)
- **Forward-Delete acts where your cursor actually is.** Pressing ⌦ right after moving the cursor could do nothing, or merge the wrong line, because it read a stale cursor position. It now uses the live cursor. (#1559.)
- **Undo no longer reverts changes that came from your other devices**, and several smaller fixes to indenting very deep lists and Shift-Tab. (#1668, #1674, #1675, #1676.)
- **Photos keep the right way up.** Images from phones that store their rotation as metadata were imported sideways. They're now rotated correctly before the metadata is removed. (#1528; PRD Addendum 17 §Q5.3.)
- **Stricter photo privacy on import.** Beyond EXIF, imported images now also have XMP, IPTC, comments and other embedded text removed, any of which can carry location or identity. (#1543; Addendum 17 §Q5.3.)
- **Empty Trash can't delete a note you've just restored.** If a note was restored while Empty Trash (or automatic trash expiry) was running, it could still be permanently deleted. Each note is now checked again at the moment of deletion. (#1379, #1383.)
- **Switching sync accounts keeps accounts separate.** Signing out of one account and into another could pick up where the old account left off and miss data. The new account now starts cleanly. (#1292, #1293.)
- **Sync never changes text while you're mid-word** in an input method (for example Japanese, Chinese or autocorrect). Remote changes now wait until the composition finishes. (#670.)
- **Better contrast for labels on coloured buttons** in every theme, and clearer focus rings on banners and recovery buttons. (#1415, #1457.)
- **iPhone and iPad:** no "end-to-end encrypted" label on older server-key vaults; the recovery-key ceremony waits for vault creation to finish; tapping elsewhere correctly dismisses the Aa sheet; links in the References sheet open notes without popping up the keyboard; background launches no longer count against safe mode. (#1599, #1541, #1511, #1397, #1048.)

**Under the hood**

- Groundwork for the Android app (not yet released): the shared editor now handles Android keyboards (autocorrect, Return after links, composition) through a dedicated input layer, plus the Android shell, journal and test infrastructure. Desktop and iOS behaviour is unchanged. (Android plan AP0–AP10.)
- UniFFI 0.28 → 0.32 for the shared Rust core, and steadier end-to-end and CI tests.
